title: Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia (HIT) Masterclass & Dialysis Anticoagulation Guide
description: 整合 HIT Immunopathogenesis, 4Ts Diagnostic Score, Direct Thrombin Inhibitors, Warfarin Microvascular Necrosis Trap 與 Hemodialysis/CRRT Anticoagulation 處置之專科課程。

sections.title: Module 1: Immunopathogenesis & Anti-PF4/Heparin Complex Biology
sections.content:
### 1. Molecular Pathophysiology Matrix

Heparin-HIT 主要分為非免疫性的 Type 1 HIT 與免疫介導的 Type 2 HIT。UFH 或 Low-Molecular-LMWHPF4 結合形成超大 Tetramer Complex，進而誘發高親和性 IgG Autoantibodies 產生。此類 Immune Complex 與 Platelet 膜上的 FcγRIIa Receptor Cross-linking，傳遞強烈的 Platelet Activation 信號，釋放大量的 Platelet Microparticles 與 Thrombin，引發全血管床的 Prothrombotic State。

| Feature | Type 1 HIT | Type 2 HIT |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mechanism | Non-immune direct platelet aggregation | Immune-mediated IgG antibodies against PF4-Heparin complexes |
| Timing of Onset | Days 1–4 after Heparin exposure | Days 5–Rapid if exposed within 100 days |
| Platelet Count Nadir | Modest drop (rarely <100,000/μL) | Profound drop (>50% decrease or nadir 20,000–60,000/μL) |
| Thrombosis Risk | Negligible | Very High (Venous & Arterial Thromboembolism) |
| Action Required | Continue Heparin, observe | Discontinue ALL Heparin immediately, start alternative non-heparin anticoagulant |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Parameter |UFH | Low-Molecular-LMWH |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Molecular Chain Length | Long saccharide chains (15,000 Da) | Short saccharide chains (4,500 Da) |
| PF4 Complex Formation | High affinity, forms large multi-molecular complexes | Lower affinity, less frequent complex formation |
| Incidence of HIT | Higher (1–5% in surgical patients) | Lower (<0.6% in surgical patients) |
| Cross-Reactivity | 100% cross-reactive | >90% cross-reactive with established HIT antibodies |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Heparin Administration ➔PF4 from alpha-granules ➔ Binding to Heparin forming PF4-Heparin Complexes ➔ Induction of Anti-PF4/Heparin IgG Antibodies ➔ Formation of Ultralarge Immune Complexes ➔ Binding & Cross-linking of FcγRIIa Receptors on Platelets ➔ Platelet Activation, Aggregation & Release of Procoagulant Microparticles ➔ Massive Thrombin Generation ➔ Venous & Arterial Thrombosis.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 以為切換成 Low-Molecular-LMWH 可以用於治療或緩解已經確診的 Type 2 HIT。
**Analysis**: 雖然 Low-Molecular-Weight Heparin 誘發 HIT 的初次發生率較低，但一旦 Anti-PF4/Heparin IgG 抗體已經形成，Low-Molecular-Weight Heparin 與 HIT 抗體的 Cross-Reactivity 高達 >90%。因此確診或高度懷疑 HIT 時，**絕對禁止**使用 Low-Molecular-Weight Heparin，必須全面停用所有 Heparin 類藥物。

sections.title: Module 2: Clinical Presentation, 4Ts Score & Diagnostic Algorithms
sections.content:
### 1.4Ts Pretest Probability Score

4Ts Score 是臨床評估 HIT 預測機率的最核心工具，包含四個評分範疇：Thrombocytopenia, Timing, Thrombosis, 以及 oTher causes。每個項目分數為 0–2 分，總分 0–8 分。

| Category | 2 Points | 1 Point | 0 Points |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Thrombocytopenia | Fall >50% and nadir ≥20,000/μL | Fall 30–50% or nadir 10,000–19,000/μL | Fall <30% or nadir <10,000/μL |
| Timing of Fall | Clear onset Days 5–10 or ≤heparin within 100 days | Onset after Day 10 or timing unclear | Onset ≤4 days without recent heparin exposure |
| Thrombosis or Sequelae | New thrombosis, skin necrosis, or acute systemic reaction | Progressive/recurrent thrombosis or red skin lesions | None |
| oTher Causes | No other cause apparent | Possible other cause present | Definite other cause present |

### 2. High-Yield Diagnostic Assay Comparison Table

| Diagnostic Assay | Test Mechanism | Sensitivity | Specificity | Primary Clinical Utility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Anti-PF4/Heparin ELISA Immunoassay | Detects circulating Anti-PF4/IgG/IgA/IgM | >99% | 70–85% | Screening assay (High NPV; negative test reliably excludes HIT) |
|SRA | Measures 14C-serotonin release from donor platelets induced by patient serum & heparin | >95% | >95% |High PPV |
| Heparin-HIPA | Visual aggregation of donor platelets washed with patient serum | >90% | >90% | Alternative confirmatory functional assay |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Clinical Suspicion of HIT ➔ Calculate 4Ts Score ➔ Score 0–Low Risk ➔ HIT Unlikely (NPV >99%) ➔ Continue Heparin, search for alternative causes ➔ Score 4–Intermediate to High Risk ➔ Discontinue ALL Heparin immediately ➔ Initiate Alternative Non-Heparin Anticoagulant ➔ Order Anti-PF4 ELISA Immunoassay ➔ If ELISA Negative ➔ Discontinue non-heparin anticoagulant ➔ If ELISA Positive ➔SRA for definitive confirmation.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 對於 4Ts Score 評估為 High Risk (6–8 分) 的患者，等待 Anti-PF4 ELISA 或 SRA 報告結果出來後才停用 Heparin。
**Analysis**: HIT 具有極高的急性血栓風險 (50% 的未治療 HIT 患者會在數日內並發 Venous or Arterial Thromboembolism)。對於 4Ts 中高風險患者，**必須在第一時間立即停用所有 Heparin 產品並啟動非肝素抗凝血劑**，絕不能等待檢驗報告。

sections.title: Module 3: Management Protocols & Direct Thrombin Inhibitor / Factor Xa Inhibitor Therapy
sections.content:
### 1. Alternative Anticoagulants Pharmacological Matrix

當確診或高度懷疑 HIT 時，首要步驟為停用所有 Heparin（包含 IV Heparin, LMWH, Heparin Flushes, 靜脈留置針 Heparin Lock）。同時必須給予 Therapeutic Dose 的非肝素抗凝血劑以預防血栓發展。

| Drug | Class | Route | Elimination Half-life | Clearance Pathway | Monitoring Target |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Argatroban |DTI | Continuous IV | 45–50 min |Safe in Renal Failure | aPTT (Target 1.5–3.0x baseline) |
| Bivalirudin |DTI | Continuous IV | 25 min | Enzymatic (80%) + Renal (20%) | aPTT (Target 1.5–2.5x baseline) |
| Fondaparinux | Indirect Factor Xa Inhibitor | Subcutaneous | 17–21 hours |Accumulates in ESRD | Anti-if needed |
|DOACs | Oral Factor Xa / Thrombin Inhibitor | Oral | 8–14 hours | Hepatic & Renal | Clinical observation |

### 2. High-Yield Warfarin Microvascular Necrosis Trap Comparison Table

| Phase | Anticoagulant Strategy | Rationale & Mechanism | Clinical Hazard / Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Acute HIT Phase | Non-Argatroban / Bivalirudin | Rapid inhibition of Thrombin, suppresses ongoing thrombosis | Safe & Effective |
|CONTRAINDICATED | Warfarin Mono-therapy | Rapid depletion of short half-life Protein C before prothrombin clearance | Microvascular Thrombosis & Venous Limb Gangrene |
| Recovery Phase (Platelet >150,000/μL) | Warfarin Overlap with DTI | Overlap DTI + Warfarin for ≥5 days until INR therapeutic for 2 consecutive days | Safe transition to oral anticoagulation |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Diagnosis of HIT ➔ Immediate Cessation of Heparin ➔ Start Argatroban IV (Initial 2 μg/kg/min; reduce to 0.5 μg/kg/min if hepatic impairment) ➔ Monitor aPTT every 2–4 hours ➔ Await Platelet Recovery (PLT >150,000/μL) ➔ Add Low-5 mg/day ➔ Co-administration causes additional INR elevation ➔ Continue DTI overlap for ≥5 days ➔ Stop DTI only when INR >4.0 on combined therapy (reflecting true INR >2.0 on Warfarin alone).

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 看到患者 Platelet 掉到 20,000/μL，給予 Platelet Transfusion 以提升血小板數量。
**Analysis**: 在 HIT 急性期，補充外源性 Platelet 等於為 Anti-PF4/Heparin Immune Complex 提供更多反應基質，會劇烈引發 Platelet Activation 與大量 Thrombin 釋放，誘發致命的 Arterial or Venous Thrombosis。因此除非發生生命危險的 Active Hemorrhage，HIT **絕對禁忌輸注 Platelet**。

sections.title: Module 4: HIT in Special Nephrology Contexts (Hemodialysis, CRRT & Renal Impairment)
sections.content:
### 1.HDCRRT 的患者常暴露於大量 UFH 或 Heparin Flushes。一旦此類患者發生 HIT，Dialysis Circuit 的抗凝處置必須全面調整。

| Modality | Circuit Anticoagulation | Systemic Anticoagulation | Dosage Adjustments in Dialysis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|HD |RCA or No Anticoagulation | Argatroban IV Infusion |Hepatic Metabolism |
|CRRT |RCA | Argatroban or Bivalirudin IV | Lower infusion rates required due to reduced clearance in critically ill ICU patients |
| Vascular Access Maintenance |Zero Heparin | Non-heparin oral/systemic regimen | Heparin-coated catheters strictly prohibited |

### 2. High-Yield Comparison Table: DTI Selection in Renal Impairment

| Agent | Elimination Path | Half-life in Normal Function | Half-life in ESRD / HD | Recommended Usage in Dialysis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Argatroban |Biliary | 45 minutes |Unchanged | Gold Standard for ESRD/No dose change for CKD |
| Bivalirudin | Enzymatic (80%) + Renal (20%) | 25 minutes | 60–90 minutes | Preferred in Cardiac Surgery / PCI; reduce dose by 50% in ESRD |
| Fondaparinux | Renal (100%) | 17 hours | >Accumulates | Contraindicated in Severe Renal Impairment (CrCl <30 mL/min) |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Dialysis Patient with Suspected HIT ➔ Immediately remove all Heparin Flushes & Heparin locks ➔ Dialysis Circuit Strategy:RCA ➔ Systemic Anticoagulation Strategy: Select Argatroban ➔ Monitor aPTT (Target 1.5–3.0x baseline) ➔Child-Pugh C / Shock Liver ➔ Reduce Argatroban infusion by 75% (to 0.5 μg/kg/min) ➔ Maintain Regional Citrate Anticoagulation in Dialysis Circuit.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 以為 Argatroban 屬於抗凝血劑，在 ESRD 或 Hemodialysis 患者身上需要降低劑量。
**Analysis**: Argatroban Hepatic Metabolism，其 Elimination Half-life 在 End-ESRD 或 Hemodialysis 患者體內維持不變 (~45 min)。因此純粹腎功能衰竭**不需要調降 Argatroban 劑量**。只有當患者合併 Severe Hepatic Impairment 或 Multi-Organ Failure 時才需要調降劑量。
